Hi Michael,

I'm reaching out on behalf of Jon Clark regarding your 2016 Nissan Altima. The $12,600 asking price stands out—it's above the top of the KBB private party range, which tops out around $12,540 and averages closer to $11,765 for this mileage.

Before we get into a serious number, we need to understand the mechanical history. Has the car been in any accidents? Are there any known issues with the transmission, engine, or suspension? Is all scheduled maintenance up to date, and do you have complete service records?

Assuming everything checks out mechanically, our starting point would be **$10,800**. If there are any repair items or deferred maintenance needs, we'll need to adjust downward by the full cost to address them.

Let us know the details on condition and history, and we can go from there.

Best regards,
Jon Clark's Buyer Agent
